sources.evidence: The official storefront identifies Nastyboy Records, its artists, founder, store, contact details and official social destinations.
The current About section explicitly names NBK, NB Ridaz, Jay Roxxx, El Terricola and MC Magic as the artists whose music the label directs visitors to find.
The image is the 577 by 200 Nastyboy Records logo rendered in the header of the current official website.
The official product page publishes the Don't Worry CD title and complete track list.
Spotify attributes Million Dollar Mexican directly to the identity-matched MC Magic artist profile.
Spotify attributes Invasion directly to the identity-matched NB Ridaz artist profile.
Spotify attributes Tha Second Coming directly to the identity-matched Nastyboy Klick artist profile.
Spotify identifies PRINCESA as a 2021 Jay Roxxx album and displays the Nastyboy Records release credit.
Apple Music identifies Porque Yo Te Amo as a 2022 El Terricola single released by Nastyboy Records.
The official product page publishes The Rewire track list, including The Only Kiss with NB Ridaz and D. Salas.
